title: shipped comments cite a directive, contract amendments and fleet, which a public reader cannot look up; and a workroom arm refuses those shapes
body:
Both rereads of v0.1.17's changes since the audited snapshot (ST0010 AC-2.7) found comments and test messages in the shipped tree that cite things a public reader cannot look up. hv ruled on 2026-10-29: publish 0.1.17 as it stands, and fix forward in 0.1.18.

## What changes

- **"directive 15"** is a ruling that no shipped file records. Cite the issue alone instead:
  - lib/cmd/doctor:1001;
  - lib/helpers:4957 and :5042;
  - tests/unit/machinepointer.bats:284;
  - tests/unit/use.bats:55 and :590.
- **"amendment A5", "A4" and "agreed by every signatory"** point at amendments that docs/dev-opt-brew.md never names. Cite T4 and the issue instead:
  - lib/cmd/doctor:933, :950 and :1209;
  - lib/helpers:5241 (A4), and the A4 sites already in the tree;
  - tests/unit/doctor.bats:908;
  - tests/unit/documentation.bats:997 to :1008, including the test name and its fail messages.
- **fleet, which does not ship:**
  - tests/lib/test_helper.bash:1577 names `fleet.bats' mkinstall_prefix`;
  - tests/unit/use.bats:107-108 says "the public snapshot leaves fleet out".

  Say neither in a shipped file.
- **"main's red"** at tests/unit/use.bats:39 and :354, which is test-process shorthand. Say what the arm checks first, in plain words.

## And a guard

tests/unit/workroom.bats refuses, in any shipped line, a reference of the shapes `directive <N>` and `amendment A<N>` (and a bare `A<N>` beside T<N>), so a later snapshot cannot carry one. Its planted lines go in the shape the file already uses.

## Done when

- The v0.1.18 snapshot carries none of these, by the same scans plus the new arm.
- Both readers have reread the changed lines.

## Resolution

- Every filed site, and the A3/A4 sites at tests/unit/use.bats:187, :874, :876 and :880, cites docs/dev-opt-brew.md's section (T4 or T5) and the issue (0250, 0235, 0246, 0230) in place of a numbered directive or amendment; documentation.bats' test name and fail messages say "the doctor sentence".
- fleet is named in neither tests/lib/test_helper.bash's stub-install comment nor use.bats' tree comment, and "main's red" reads as what the arm checks.
- tests/unit/workroom.bats' citations arm refuses a directive or an amendment by number, and a bare A<N> beside a T<N>, in every shipped line but CHANGELOG.md, RELEASES.md and RELEASES/, whose notes keep the wording they shipped with.
- Landed on main at `bbb77cc5`, built by dc (refs/bank/dc/0292, 55985176).
- Desk evidence: hv's run of the 13 files on main at bbb77cc5 (workroom, doctor, documentation, machinepointer, use, helpers, contract, neutral, readonlygit, harness, vendoredmd, installhints, help), 490 of 490 ok, 2 skips that are helpers.bats' expected-skip arms of require_command (420, 422); the citations arm is ok 7. Kept at devbin-vc/st0010/res0292/hv-run-0292.out.
